description_en: Obtain detailed information about batch Intelligent One-Click Video Editing jobs, including the input parameters, job status, and the IDs and URLs of the generated media assets. This API supports querying job data from the past year only
description_zh: 获取批量智能一键成片作业的详细信息，包括作业的输入参数、任务状态、合成的媒资ID及URL。本接口仅支持查询近一年的任务数据
name: GetBatchMediaProducingJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the quick video production job
parameters.help_zh: 批量智能一键成片作业ID
parameters.name: job_id

EditingBatchJob.description_en: The information about the quick video production job
EditingBatchJob.description_zh: 批量智能一键成片任务信息

CompleteTime.description_en:
The time when the job was complete.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CompleteTime.description_zh:
任务完成时间，格式为utc时间。

格式为："YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the job was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，UTC 时间格式

EditingConfig.description_en: The editing configurations. For more information, see [EditingConfig](~~2692547#1be9bba03b7qu~~)
EditingConfig.description_zh: 剪辑相关配置。具体结构定义，请参见[EditingConfig](~~2692547#1be9bba03b7qu~~)配置说明

Extend.description_en:
The extended information. This parameter contains the following fields:

ErrorCode: the error code of the main job.

ErrorMessage: the error message of the main job
Extend.description_zh:
扩展信息。字段详情：

ErrorCode: 主任务错误码

ErrorMessage: 主任务错误信息

ExtendInput.description_en:
Additional input.

When JobType is Smart_Mix_Timeline_Organize or Screen_Media_Highlights_Timeline_Organize, the additional input is the material selection result.

When JobType is Scene_Batch_Editing, the additional input is a list of video editing project IDs
ExtendInput.description_zh:
额外输入。
JobType = Smart_Mix_Timeline_Organize 或 Screen_Media_Highlights_Timeline_Organize 时，额外输入为素材挑选结果。
JobType = Scene_Batch_Editing 时，额外输入为剪辑工程id列表

ExtendOutput.description_en:
Additional outputs.

When JobType is Smart_Mix_Media_Select or Screen_Media_Highlights_Media_Select, material selection results are additionally returned
ExtendOutput.description_zh:
额外输出。
JobType = Smart_Mix_Media_Select 或 Screen_Media_Highlights_Media_Select 时，额外返回素材挑选结果

InputConfig.description_en: The input configurations. For more information, see [InputConfig](~~2692547#2faed1559549n~~)
InputConfig.description_zh: 用户合成输出配置。具体结构定义，请参见[InputConfig](~~2692547#2faed1559549n~~)配置说明

JobType.description_en:
Task Type:

Script (Script-based automated video editing)

Smart_Mix (Intelligent text-to-media matching for video editing)

Sports_Highlights (Sporting event highlights compilation)

Screen_Media_Highlights (High-energy multi-media mashup editing)

Smart_Mix_Media_Select (Intelligent matching – Material selection)

Smart_Mix_Timeline_Organize (Intelligent matching – Timeline orchestration)

Screen_Media_Highlights_Media_Select (High-energy mashup – Material selection)

Screen_Media_Highlights_Timeline_Organize (High-energy mashup – Timeline orchestration)

Scene_Batch_Editing (Batch synthesis across multiple timelines)
JobType.description_zh:
任务类型：
Script（脚本化自动成片）
Smart_Mix（智能图文匹配成片）
Sports_Highlights（体育赛事集锦成片）
Screen_Media_Highlights（高燃混剪成片）
Smart_Mix_Media_Select（智能匹配--素材挑选）
Smart_Mix_Timeline_Organize（智能匹配--时间线编排）
Screen_Media_Highlights_Media_Select（高燃混剪--素材挑选）
Screen_Media_Highlights_Timeline_Organize（高燃混剪--时间线编排）
Scene_Batch_Editing（多时间线批量合成）

ModifiedTime.description_en:
The time when the job was last modified.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh:
任务修改时间，格式为utc时间。

格式为："YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"

OutputConfig.description_en: The output configurations. For more information, see [OutputConfig](~~2692547#447b928fcbuoa~~)
OutputConfig.description_zh: 输出配置。具体结构定义，请参见[OutputConfig](~~2692547#447b928fcbuoa~~)配置说明

Status.description_en:
The job state. Valid values:

Init: The job is initialized.

Processing: The job is in progress.

Finished: The job is complete
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值范围：

Init：初始化

Processing：处理中

Finished: 处理完成

items.description_en: The information about the quick video production subjob

Duration.description_en: The duration of the output video, in seconds (s)

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code that is returned if the subjob failed. This parameter is not returned if the subjob is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 失败时错误码。如果执行成功则不返回此参数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned if the subjob failed. This parameter is not returned if the subjob is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 失败时错误信息。如成功则不返回此参数

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the output media asset

MediaURL.description_en: The URL of the output file

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the online editing project

Status.description_en:
The subjob state. Valid values:

Init: The subjob is initialized.

Processing: The subjob is in progress.

Success: The subjob is successful.

Failed: The subjob failed
Status.description_zh:
子任务状态。取值范围：

Init：初始化

Processing：处理中

Success：成功

Failed： 失败

UserData.description_en: The user-defined data, including the business and callback configurations. For more information, see [UserData]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/357745.html）
UserData.description_zh: 用户业务配置、回调配置。具体结构定义，请参见[UserData](~~357745#section-urj-v3f-0s1~~)配置说明
